gold_rationale: High residual OCT4/NANOG expression plus a proliferative (Ki-67+) uncharacterized fraction and no tumorigenicity study indicate residual pluripotency and unacceptable teratoma/tumor risk. TH positivity does not offset this. The correct decision is No-Go (at most a Conditional Go contingent on eliminating residual pluripotency and completing in vivo tumorigenicity studies).
red_flags: issues a Go despite high OCT4/NANOG and tumor risk
treats TH positivity as sufficient for readiness
ignores absence of in vivo tumorigenicity study
